title: Honor world-clock format and show_date settings
description:
## Problem

The public `[[calendar.clocks]]` contract advertises two row-level presentation settings that production rendering does not honor.

## Evidence at 299fc13

* `crates/thegn-core/src/config_calendar.rs:207-230` documents `format` as a per-row strftime override and `show_date` as an always-show-date switch.
* `CalendarConfig::active_clocks` copies `format` into `ResolvedClock` but drops `show_date` entirely.
* `crates/thegn-core/src/calendar/tz.rs:255-326` retains `ResolvedClock.format`, but `read_clocks` never reads it and `ClockReading` carries neither resolved format nor show-date policy.
* `crates/thegn-host/src/detail/calendar/render.rs:374-425` hard-codes either `%H:%M` or 12-hour `h:mmam`, always emits a weekday, and only emits a date delta of `±1d`. Neither advertised setting reaches this code.
* Validation still accepts and validates `calendar.clocks[*].format`, so valid configuration silently has no effect.

This is a truthful-API defect, not only a missing convenience. A user can successfully validate configuration that the runtime discards.

## Required design

Carry the validated row policy through one typed resolved-clock/reading contract and render it consistently. Define how an empty format inherits the calendar default, how `show_date` affects the date/day-delta cells, and whether second-bearing formats alter the calendar refresh cadence. Treat formatted config output as untrusted terminal text under THE-471.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `show_date` survives config resolution and deterministically changes the rendered row for same-day and cross-day clocks.
- [ ] A non-empty per-clock `format` controls that row; empty format inherits the documented global setting.
- [ ] All supported strftime output is length-bounded and terminal-safe, including `%n`/`%t` or equivalent control-producing directives.
- [ ] If a format displays seconds, scheduling refreshes often enough to keep it truthful, or validation rejects/documentedly normalizes that format.
- [ ] Unknown zones and the synthesized home row retain explicit, tested behavior.
- [ ] Unit tests prove mixed row formats, 12/24-hour inheritance, `show_date`, DST, fractional-offset zones, and narrow rendering.
- [ ] Schema/help/example docs match the implemented contract; no accepted field is dead.
